channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: US official claims Trump holds all the cards in Iran talks
item.description: US State Department Spokesman Tommy Pigott says President Donald Trump ‘holds all of the cards’ in talks with Tehran.

item.title: Iran pitches US a seven-day end to the war at UNGA
item.description: Iran has pitched a proposal to open the Strait of Hormuz in seven days - if the US meets its conditions.

item.title: Yemen’s government offers amnesty to Houthi defectors
item.description: Yemen’s president called on citizens to join the armed forces, and offered amnesty to Iran-backed Houthi rebels.

item.title: Yemeni leader urges public to enlist, offers amnesty to Houthi defectors
item.description: Rashad al-Alimi pledges amnesty for Houthi defectors in first speech since losing ground on the western Red Sea coast.

item.title: Iran war live: Tehran offers US plan to reopen Hormuz within seven days
item.description: Iran's FM says the "choice rests with the US" to approve the proposed seven-day proposal to reopen Hormuz.

item.title: Iran says it awaits US response on seven-day roadmap to end war
item.description: Tehran says the plan would reopen the Strait of Hormuz and resume nuclear talks within a week if Washington agrees.

item.title: Iran to reopen Strait of Hormuz within a week if US agrees to plan
item.description: Iran says it has given the US a seven-day plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, with the choice to accept now up to them

item.title: Mbappe goal overshadowed by knee injury to mar Zidane debut France win
item.description: Kylian Mbappe scores the only goal of France's win in Turkiye, but Real Madrid striker immediately forced off by injury.

item.title: Iran offers US deal to reopen Strait of Hormuz in seven days
item.description: Asked about the Iranian proposal, a US official told the BBC "constructive discussions" were taking place through mediators.

item.title: Netanyahu defends Israeli military action as delegates walk out before UN speech
item.description: The Israeli leader labels those who left his speech at the UN General Assembly as "moral cowards".
